claim: Microplastics in drinking water are harmless at current exposure levels.
claim_clarity_assessment: Harmless is categorical; current exposure has no fixed as-of date.
claim_evidence_interpretation: The 2019 source expresses limited-information uncertainty, not demonstrated absence of harm at all current exposures.
date_assessment: candidate-p2-env-004-e01: Published 2019-08-22; current levels refers to the information available then.
provenance_assessment: One WHO review summary, not independent contemporary measurements.
research_concerns: A short historical risk statement cannot establish present-day harmlessness. Missing initial qualification needs reviewer attention.
recommendation_reason: A short historical risk statement cannot establish present-day harmlessness. Missing initial qualification needs reviewer attention.
